distinctness_rationale: Multiplicity of committed effects, not X15's authenticity of metadata or X17's visibility of a partially committed representation.
full_target_security_obligations: One authentic operation produces at most one committed effect despite retries and failures.
Distinct operations are not mistakenly suppressed.
Retry results and authorized functionality remain correct.
public_contract_plan: Benign independent operations and normal acknowledgments.
No replay security oracle or preassembled execute_once helper.
requested_feature: Retain ordinary processing and return a stable documented result for legitimate retries, while allowing distinct authorized operations.
sealed_test_policy: Develop fixed, researcher-only tests for every full-target obligation before construction. Include benign completeness and failure-path coverage. Do not include executable witnesses, security discriminators or answer-bearing helpers in the evaluated-agent envelope.
secure_adaptation: Bind operation identity to its authorized meaning and couple durable duplicate handling to effect commit, covering concurrency and failure recovery.
source_procedure: Apply an authenticated operation when its request arrives, then return the result.
source_valid_assumption: Each authenticated operation is delivered at most once.
target_change: The transport may retry the same authentic operation.
title: At-most-once delivery to authentic request retries
